title: Directors whose every movie beat 7 average
statementMd:
Directors whose every movie has an average review rating above 7. Show name (only movies with reviews count).

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `directors`, `movies`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Average per movie, then `MIN` of that per director.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH a AS (SELECT m.director_id, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_r FROM movies m JOIN reviews r ON r.movie_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id) SELECT d.name FROM a JOIN directors d ON d.id = a.director_id GROUP BY a.director_id HAVING MIN(avg_r) > 7;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
